verified: CachedRecipe.process() is public void with descriptor ()V; HEAD precedes useEnergy, operatingTicks increment, finishProcessing and useResources.
CachedRecipe.getRecipe() is public and returns the protected final recipe identity; Class.getMethod can find the inherited public API.
The private static apply(BasinBlockEntity,Recipe,boolean) returns boolean; the full injection descriptor matches the pinned source.
Both match(simulated) and apply(actual) reach the three-argument method; its HEAD is before capability lookup, simulated extraction and actual input consumption.
Mixer and press share BasinRecipe.apply; other Create processes are outside this adapter.
RecipeManager.apply and replaceRecipes replace immutable byName map while the manager can retain its identity.
RecipeManager.getRecipes returns the immutable byName.values snapshot; the revised adapter uses that snapshot as the identity generation token.

findings.issue: A RecipeManager object is reused during replacement. An index keyed only by manager identity could preserve stale permissions and quarantine all replacement objects.
findings.resolution: Parent changed the generation token to manager.getRecipes() immutable map-values snapshot. Index tests verify stale identities are removed when the generation changes.

findings.issue: EntityRobit.baseTick calls RecipeCacheLookupMonitor.updateAndProcess outside a standard BlockEntityTicker. The cached-recipe adapter has no owning block context and denies this operation even after epoch48.
findings.next_step: A verified entity-owner/team adapter is required to restore staged Robit smelting; do not allow context-free operations globally.

findings.issue: PotionMixingRecipes synthesizes recipe objects outside RecipeManager. They have no indexed identity and remain stage100; normal registered mixing/compacting recipes are a separate path.
findings.next_step: Index trusted generated brewing recipes using verified output components and stage rules before allowing them.
